edges.reason: approveAndCall passes msg.sender, tokens and data into an external receiveApproval call.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written before the external call, leaving state mid-transaction.
The arbitrary spender contract regains control while approveAndCall has not finished.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external contract whose behavior is not constrained.
The tokenAddress contract can re-enter or manipulate state during the external transfer.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
The constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged state.
Caller-controlled msg.sender becomes the owner address.
safeAdd performs unchecked a + b protected only by a require overflow check.
safeSub performs a - b protected only by a require underflow check.
safeMul performs unchecked a * b protected only by a require check.
safeDiv divides by b with only a zero-check guard.
transfer reads and debits balances of msg.sender.
approve records the allowance granted by msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes the allowance granted to msg.sender.
approveAndCall records allowance for msg.sender before calling out.
acceptOwnership validates msg.sender against newOwner.
Balances are summed through safeAdd during transfers.
Balances are debited through safeSub during transfers.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates balances for from and to accounts.
transferFrom decreases the allowed mapping for the spender.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts the balance held by address(0).
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
The constructor assigns the full supply to the fixed deployer address.
The constructor sets _totalSupply.
The constructor sets the symbol.
The constructor sets the name.
The constructor sets the decimals.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.

transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance updates.
Untrusted bytes data is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval callback.
Attacker-supplied tokenAddress becomes the external call target for ERC20Interface.
